description_en: Appends outbound call cases to a specified predictive outbound campaign under an instance
description_zh: 调用AppendCases添加外呼名单到指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动
name: AppendCases

fields.help_en: The agent ID of the specified agent to which the call is transferred. If this field is not empty, the system transfers the call to the specified agent. If this field is empty, the system assigns the call to an idle agent in the skill group
fields.help_zh: 坐席ID，指定的转接坐席，该字段不为空，系统会将该电话转至对应坐席；该字段若为空，系统会分配给技能组中的空闲坐席
fields.name: agent_id

fields.help_en: The caller number. If this field is not empty, the outbound call system preferentially uses the provided number as the caller to initiate the call. If this field is empty, the system automatically selects a caller number
fields.help_zh: 主叫号码，该字段若不为空，外呼式会优先使用传入的号码作为主叫发起呼叫；该字段若为空，系统会自动选取主叫发起呼叫
fields.name: caller

fields.help_en: The custom variables defined by the customer. The value is a JSON object that contains up to 10 properties. The name and value of each property are defined by the customer
fields.help_zh: 客户自定义变量，格式为JSON对象，对象最多包含10个属性，每个属性的名称和值均由客户自定义
fields.name: custom_variables

fields.help_en: The masked callee number. If this field is not empty, the callee number is masked based on custom rules defined by the customer. You only need to enter the masked callee number. If a masked callee number is used, the masked number is displayed in certain scenarios, and the actual callee number cannot be viewed
fields.help_zh: 脱敏后的被叫号码，如果该字段不为空，表示需要对被叫号码脱敏，脱敏规则由客户自行定义，只需将脱敏后的被叫号码填入即可，使用脱敏被叫会导致某些场景下看到的是脱敏后的被叫号码，无法查看真实被叫号码
fields.name: masked_callee

fields.help_en: The phone number of the contact
fields.name: phone_number

fields.help_en: The business ID, which is the identifier in the customer's business system and is used for integration scenarios
fields.help_zh: 业务ID，客户业务系统标识，用于集成场景
fields.name: reference_id

parameters.help_en: The list of outbound call cases in the request body
parameters.name: body

Data.description_en: The list of processing results for appending outbound call cases
Data.description_zh: 追加外呼名单的处理结果列表

CustomVariables.description_en: The custom variables of the contact, represented as a JSON string
CustomVariables.description_zh: 联系人自定义变量，使用 JSON 字符串表示

PhoneNumber.description_en: The phone number of the contact

ReferenceId.description_en: The unique identifier of the contact in the customer's business system
ReferenceId.description_zh: 客户业务系统中的联系人唯一标识
